It needs no unique, only weapons on the ground and a Necromancer shell to keep them alive.

builds.name: Arc Elementalist
builds.summary: Arc Elementalist casts one lightning spell and lets the chains do the aiming, then pays for the single target with the tools the ascendancy already owns. Shaper of Storms guarantees the shock, Mastermind of Discord makes the Wave of Conviction exposure stronger, and Elemental Overload keeps its damage bonus up from Arc's own critical strikes. The defence is a large life pool, capped resistances, Saffell's Frame's maximum resistances, Determination armour, Arctic Armour while stationary and the endurance charges from Enduring Cry. Cerberus Limb and Saffell's Frame are the only required uniques, both cheap.

builds.name: Arc Totem Hierophant
builds.summary: The Tendrils totem is the default link: Lightning Tendrils of Eccentricity channels a semicircle in front of the totem, and every fifth pulse is stronger (a much larger area and an automatic critical strike). Marylene's Fallacy multiplies that guaranteed critical strike into the boss hit and Lioneye's Remorse is the armour and life behind the flasks; Arc sits in the four-link helmet for open layouts. The measured damage is per totem. Both required uniques are cheap common drops; there is no expensive required unique.

builds.name: Boneshatter Juggernaut

Boneshatter trades a little life for stacks, so the gear is armour and resistances, the axe is a rare with attack speed, and the ascendancy makes the trauma survivable. Herald of Purity and Vulnerability turn the axe into damage, and no unique is required, which is what a strength build needs on day one of a solo league.

builds.name: Righteous Fire Chieftain
builds.summary: Righteous Fire on the Chieftain shell: a tanky fire aura that burns enemies while you walk, backed by armour, life regeneration and fire resistance. Fire Trap levels the character, then Righteous Fire comes online at red maps with Purity of Fire, Vitality and Enduring Cry making the self-burn net positive. Malevolence and Flammability carry the damage; the legal jewel caps keep the single-target and clear numbers modest, but the build is cheap, forgiving and has no required unique.
